title: Two YouTubers Took Hollywood. Star Wars Just Got Walked Off.
subtitle: Weekend Recap May 29–31, 2026 · Hollywood-First Reflection
summary: Before we get to India, we have to talk about Hollywood — because two YouTube directors just took the top two spots at the US box office. A24's Backrooms opens $81M directed by 20-year-old Kane Parsons (studio record, 3.2× the previous mark). Obsession ($750K budget) crossed $100M domestic with the first W2+W3 dual-growth pattern since E.T. 1982. Mandalorian & Grogu cratered -69% W2 (steeper than Solo). Then to India: Mollywood-Marathi-Tamil podium, Drishyam 3 past ₹100 Cr, Deool Band 2 at 340% ROI, Bhooth Bangla still holding at W7.
